thread:
alex: quick heads-up — trying to onboard orca-mini-1 weights and CI is failing the config schema lint. error: missing tokenizer.type and weights.location mismatch. anyone seen this pattern?

sophie: can you paste the lint output? :eyes:

alex: sure — from the job: 
```
ERROR model-config-schema: missing required field 'tokenizer.type'
ERROR model-config-schema: field 'weights' must be object with 's3_path' or 'local_path'
```

alex: config excerpt i'm trying to use: 
```json
{
  "model": "orca-mini-1",
  "weights": "s3://redwood-models/orca/mini-1/weights.pt",
  "tokenizer": {
    "vocab": "orca-vocab.json"
  },
  "quantization": "int8"
}
```

jordan: ah — weights needs to be an object, not a string. we enforce either {"s3_path": ...} or {"local_path": ...} so the runtime can attach storage config. also tokenizer.type required (eg `sentencepiece` vs `byte_bpe`).

maria: also watch out: orca's tokenizer is sentencepiece and we ship a .spm file, not a json vocab. if tokenizer.vocab points to a json it will fail at runtime. should be `tokenizer.model: orca.spm` and `tokenizer.type: sentencepiece`.

alex: ok will change weights -> {"s3_path": ...} and add tokenizer.type. two quick Qs: 1) should we accept either `tokenizer.model` or `tokenizer.vocab` in schema v2? 2) quantization = "int8" is allowed? CI flagged quantization as enum mismatch in some configs.

sophie: for 1) i'd prefer normalize to `tokenizer.model` + `tokenizer.type`. legacy `vocab` makes downstream loader ambiguous. Let's add a compat-layer that maps `vocab` -> `model` only if type==byte_bpe.
sophie: for 2) quantization allowed set is ["none","int8","int4","nf4"] in schema v2. if CI complained maybe you had a stray capitalization.

jordan: i can add a small schema rule: if tokenizer.model endswith `.spm` and tokenizer.type missing -> auto-set type=sentencepiece (lint warning). that keeps onboarding smooth.
maria: +1. but make it a warning not auto-fix in repo — we want the config file explicit for reproducibility.

lint-bot: rule E201 triggered on 1768405123: 'weights must be object' — see https://git.redwood.ai/rules/model-config#E201

alex: PR incoming in a sec — i'll 1) convert weights to object, 2) add tokenizer.type and model path, 3) normalize quantization lowercasing in loader. pinging reviewers @sophie @jordan @maria for quick look.

maria: will review. also add a tiny unit test that loads the config and runs tokenizer.detect() to surface model/vocab mismatches. example: `pytest tests/test_model_configs.py::test_tokenizer_model_exists`

sophie: also update docs snippet in docs/model-onboarding.md to show the new weights object shape. small doc change + changelog entry (v2 schema note).

jordan: on the linter side i’ll add the warning rule and a code sample for auto-detect logic. will mark it as non-blocking for now but recommend follow-up.

alex: thanks — PR number is https://git.redwood.ai/p/1234. marking as draft until tests pass.

infra-bot: CI job config-lint passed on branch alex/orca-config-fix (jobs: schema-lint, unit).

alex: CI green, tests added. can someone merge and backport changelog?

maria: merging now. backport to release/next for Dedicated onboarding.

sophie: added a short note in docs and a schema migration step in release notes.

jordan: i’ll open a follow-up to change linter behavior to warn-on-vocab and add the small detection helper.

alex: awesome — thanks team :thumbsup:
